verdict.rationale: Manufact exposes its own platform data (organizations, servers, deployments, logs) as MCP tools so an agent can query things like server lists via an MCP client (manufact-docs-14, manufact-docs-31), and there's a public mcp-catalog with checklist scores (manufact-docs-33) plus API keys for REST/CI access (manufact-docs-17). However there is no documented public registry/catalog API for discovering third-party servers and tools programmatically, and a direct probe for an OpenAPI/swagger spec returned 404s (manufact-probe-2), so the 'documented API for programmatic catalog discovery' aspect is thin. Missing for 10: a documented REST/OpenAPI spec for catalog/registry queries, and evidence the mcp-catalog is queryable programmatically rather than just browsable.
